mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM content) AS content_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person) AS person_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM member) AS member_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM collection) AS collection_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_comment) AS comment_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report_comment) AS report_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM report_comment WHERE status IN ('RECEIVED','PROCESSING')) AS report_open_cnt FROM dual
SELECT content_id, NVL(title_ko, title_org) AS title, TO_CHAR(release_year,'YYYY') AS release_year, country, TO_CHAR(created_dt,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS created_dt FROM content ORDER BY content_id
SELECT person_id, NVL(name_ko, name_org) AS name, TO_CHAR(created_dt,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS created_dt FROM person ORDER BY person_id
SELECT member_id, email, nickname, role, TO_CHAR(created_dt,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS created_dt FROM member ORDER BY member_id
SELECT notice_id, title, important, status, view_count, TO_CHAR(created_dt,'YYYY/MM/DD') AS created_dt FROM notice ORDER BY notice_id DESC
